snippet.title: AntiMatcher — Announcement Trailer (Demo available now!)
snippet.description:
Play the demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4336520/AntiMatcher
Web version of the demo available on itch.io: https://legigo.itch.io/antimatcher

AntiMatcher is an abstract puzzle game about annihilating bubbles.

Made by Dito and Gigo:
https://bsky.app/profile/terzalo.com
https://gigomakes.com/
